claims.text: The authentication activity originating from 195.129.24.210 and 218.188.2.4 shows distinct patterns.

The group from 195.129.24.210 contains 15 lines of authentication failures, all of which are attempts to access the root user account, with a notable burst of activity on Jul 1 10:56, where 9 authentication failures occur within a 3-second window, and two earlier failures on Jun 30 20:16.

In contrast, the group from 218.188.2.4 contains 14 lines of authentication failures, also targeting the root user, but spread out over two days, Jun 14 and Jun 15, with a cluster of 10 failures on Jun 15 12:12, all within the same second, and two additional failures a minute later.

The intensity and recurrence of authentication attempts from 195.129.24.210, particularly the concentrated burst on Jul 1, suggest more suspicious behavior compared to 218.188.2.4, which, although showing a cluster of attempts, does not exhibit the same level of persistence over time as seen with 195.129.24.210.
The root cause of the suspicious behavior is that these repeated authentication failures from 195.129.24.210 recur without any corrective action in between, indicating a potential ongoing threat.
